title: Providers
description: The model APIs this workspace can call. Keys are encrypted at rest and never shown again.
noPermission: Only admins and the owner can add or change providers.

kinds.deepseek: Official DeepSeek API: capable, low-cost models with tool calling.
kinds.anthropic: Claude models through the official Anthropic API.
kinds.openai_compatible: Any API that speaks the OpenAI chat format (vLLM, Ollama, OpenRouter…).
kinds.test: Deterministic scripted model: no network, no cost. Ideal to try Gouvra.
